notes: v2.9.73 LIVE FIX: Corrects the live Young-Cha entry/exit mistakes seen in RFHIC and LS Marine Solution. Opening bars with dominant upper-wick rejection are no longer accepted as Young1, preventing RFHIC-style spike/fade false entries. Cha now starts from a real pullback after at least a 35% retracement instead of waiting for only 65% deep retracements, and the earliest valid Young-Cha structure is locked so PUMA does not keep rebasing to later highs and chase. If Cha is missed, Young2 still requires a bullish candle body through the locked Young1 prior high. A new quick-profit rule exits valid Young-Cha positions after at least 1% peak gain when price rolls over by 0.35% from the post-entry peak, while the existing +4% partial-profit rule remains as a fallback. Other indicator and account-summary rules are unchanged.
